svg.title: These labels are countable and include every singleton old label; enumeration by N only names them. Expand the old gas times Q j(1 + (elj −1)), justified by absolute summability. In a nonzero term each attachment meets a flag supplied by an old inventory and hence an old support. Every component therefore contains an old forced label. Components give disjoint new supports with inventories covering all flags. Conversely a permitted new collection recovers the unique old label and attachment sets by union; nonempty atom supports prevent shared atoms. Exact inventory and disjointness recover local old eligibility. Products agree, proving
